data.description: VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Rejoignez la Direction IARD Entreprise Sud-Ouest, métier en plein développement avec des objectifs de croissance ambitieux dont la raison d'être est d'apporter des solutions d'assurance IARD adaptées aux besoins multiples de nos clients Entreprises afin de pérenniser leur activité, moteur du tissu économique régional. Au sein des pôles Souscription Construction et RC IARD Entreprise Sud-Ouest organisés en 4 équipes dont deux sur Bordeaux-Pessac et deux sur Toulouse-Balma, nous recherchons un collaborateur dont les 2 missions principales seront: de qualifier / indexer les e-mails reçus de la part de distributeurs (Agents Généraux et Courtiers) dans le logiciel OMEGA de répartir/affecter les dossiers de souscription et de gestion dans les équipes sur la base des consignes données par les managers des 2 sites et le responsable de branche VOTRE PROFIL Compétences attendues : Rigueur et organisation Maitrise de l'environnement informatique Esprit d'équipe (sans obligation de connaissance en assurance IARD) POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue ! 😊 VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !) Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous ! Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking". Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?

data.title: Deputy Governance Manager, UK & Lloyd’s
data.description: AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Deputy Governance Manager, UK & Lloyd’s is a role supporting the management committee structure of the two key regulated AXA XL companies in the UK, including a large Lloyd’s managing agency. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the efficient management of the UK entities, as well as advising senior management and other stakeholders on corporate governance processes and best practice. The role will have a first line report to the Governance Manager, UK & Lloyd’s, with a second line report to the Chief of Staff, CFO UK & Lloyd’s. The role will be based in London. What you’ll be doing What will your essential responsibilities include? To support the efficient and effective operation of the management committee level of the governance framework of AXA XL’s two key regulated insurance companies (AXA XL Underwriting Agencies (‘AXUAL’) and AXA XL Insurance Company UK Limited (AXICL UK’) in the UK, with a particular focus on supporting Finance governance reporting and associated committees. This role requires working closely with the Governance Manager and liaising with senior stakeholders with the following responsibilities: Committee governance Act as Committee Secretary for the following AXUAL and AXICL UK legal entities: Reinsurance Review Committee, Regulatory Reporting and Approvals Committee, and other committees as required from time to time; Assist in the implementation and embedding of the corporate governance framework, including: meeting coordination; agenda setting; annual planning; meeting sequencing; production of committee packs; tracking actions; facilitating reviews and approvals; and, preparing high‑quality minutes Support the effective operation of committees by ensuring efficient information flows and appropriate escalation of matters which arise through the governance framework as appropriate Monitor key business items and coordinate escalation through the management committee governance structure to the Board and its committees where required. Maintain core governance records, including terms of reference, committee membership, minutes, action logs, and escalation documentation across the executive committee governance framework. Contribute and support working groups to support oversight, delivery of required actions, and alignment with formal governance processes. Provide support to the Company Secretarial team on corporate governance matters and assist with ad‑hoc and special projects as needed. Finance governance and reporting Driving governance and project oversight for financial reporting related matters and processes within the UK & Lloyd’s Finance team’s responsibility, including preparing and maintaining project reporting documentation, action management, communicating progress, risks, implications, and escalation requirements Provide support to the UK & Lloyd’s Finance team in their delivery of financial reports for committees and other statutory and regulatory reporting (FCA, PRA, Lloyd’s). What you’ll bring We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills: Background in corporate governance with proven experience as a governance professional or company secretary / part qualified company secretary preferred Knowledge of UK company law in general and particularly the Companies Act 2006 preferred Previous financial services sector experience preferred Proven minute writing skills, preferably gained within financial services. Interpersonal Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication and influencing skills. Ability to work in an international, multicultural environment. Ability to work independently and on own initiative whilst being part of a wider team. Ability to prioritise conflicting needs, progress matters expeditiously and follow through on projects to successful completion. A proactive approach to problem-solving with good decision-making capabilities. Prior experience of the Lloyd’s market desirable, but not essential. A relevant degree and/or Corporate Governance Institute qualified or part qualified What we offer Inclusion AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed. Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe. Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Total Rewards AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do. We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence. Sustainability At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations. Our Pillars: Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans. Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions. Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting. AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving. For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability. Who we are AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it. How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty. With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward. Learn more at axaxl.com

data.description: VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS Le security leader est le représentant de la sécurité du SI, rattaché au département gestion du risque cyber de la DSSI AXA France il met en œuvre un accompagnement sécurité de haut niveau sur les projets IT en construisant une relation forte avec les équipes métiers. Le security leader en charge des filiales : - Assure la représentation de l'activité Information Sécurity in Project dans les instances de gouvernance ou il intervient en présentant les indicateurs sécurité du périmètres et en construisant les messages associés - Travail en interaction avec les autres équipes DSSI intervenant sur le périmètre des filiales (sécurisation de l'infrastructure, pentest). - Assure la supervision, le contrôle et le conseil cyber aux RSSI locaux des filiales en mesurant notamment la maturité des pratiques ISP et en vérifiant la bonne application de la politique de sécurité AXA France - Porte et dimensionne l'offre AXA France ISP (Information Security in Project) à destination des filiales sans RSSI locaux, construit et valorise les indicateurs associés. - Anime les deux consultants cyber en charge des analyses sécurité et de due diligence des sous traitants pour le compte des filiales sans RSSI locaux VOTRE PROFIL De formation supérieure, vous disposez de plus de 10 d’expérience en cyber sécurité. Vous êtes un très bon connaisseur de l’IT et de la cyber sécurité avec une expérience avérée sur l’activité de conseil sécurité dans les projets IT (ISP). Vous avez un bon relationnel, une capacité à convaincre et à faire adhérer vos interlocuteurs, de la rigueur dans le formalisme et le suivi, ainsi que la capacité d’apprendre des notions/technologies nouvelles. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux. Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier par exemple : D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ; D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ; D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ; De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ; Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue ! 😊 VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !) Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales. Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous ! Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire, AXA France se distingue comme la filiale la plus importante du Groupe en termes de chiffre d'affaires et d'effectifs. Leader sur les marchés de l'assurance, de la santé et de la prévoyance, l'entreprise offre à ses équipes un cadre de travail moderne et agréable en "smartworking". Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nous avons conçu un dispositif d'intégration baptisé "Welcome@AXA" pour accompagner vos premiers pas parmi nous avec attention. En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : depuis 2020, nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement. Alors, prêt à postuler ?

data.title: Technical Delivery Manager
data.description: Technical Delivery Manager(EBS) Bangalore, Karnataka, India As the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM) this role will oversee application(s) within Global Technology (GT) that require analysis, development, production support & maintenance activities. This role requires responsibility operationally and administratively for other team members (BA, PMs, Developers, etc.). This role may work in different methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.). What you’ll be DOING What will your essential responsibilities include? Understanding of the applications and products under their portfolio, including function, business and key operational process and ensuring teams deliver value to the business with the appropriate stakeholders regardless of methodology (Waterfall, Agile, etc.). Ensures the software development lifecycle (SDLC) is followed consistently & effectively through CI/CD, tooling, and collaboration with stakeholders. A keen ability to execute and deliver results, including delivering technical projects on time and on budget through planning, execution, and delivery. Approach tasks proactively and anticipate needs of the business & team members. Think quickly and have the flexibility to (re-) prioritize multiple work streams/ projects/ tasks without sacrificing quality. Act with a sense of urgency. Work closely with senior team members and stakeholders to gather and clarify basic business requirements and ensure they are accurately documented and understood. Ensure that requirements are communicated clearly to the development team and accurately reflected in the final product. Work with the Business Analysts to ensure that requirements/user stories are well-defined, prioritized, and understood by the development team. Ensure collaborative refinement sessions are scheduled with the team and stakeholders. Responsible for gathering estimates for applications and products that this role is responsible for and partnering with appropriate team members to support the estimation process. Work with the appropriate team members within GT to ensure security is integrated into the development process and are compliant with AXA XL’s security policies. Responsible for ensuring security compliance, security controls are implemented and maintained, security assessments & audits, risk management, AXA XL’s governance forums, and anything else security related. Ensure that the team complies with relevant audit requirements and standards including remediation activities, documentation of processes and procedures. Contribute to ongoing process improvements by sharing observations and assisting in implementing best practices, especially around Agile/Scrum methodologies and automation initiatives. Responsible for developing, mentoring and providing HR oversight for assigned team members. Support vendor coordination activities, including tracking deliverables, assisting with contract documentation, and ensuring vendor activities align with project timelines. Help manage workload and resource allocation within the team, ensuring tasks are assigned and completed efficiently. You will report to Delivery Lead. What you will BRING We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills: Required Skills and Abilities: Outstanding hands-on development and support experience with Oracle eBusiness R12 FAH/General Ledger is required. Outstanding hands-on development and support experience in the Oracle eBusiness R12 Oracle Web Applications Desktop Integrator (Web ADI). Ability to take up the challenges and run the required translation touch poin meetings with finance stake holders and business user for the eBusinees R12 suite. Should poses the hands on experience EBS GL, AR, AP, FAH and WebADI modules and good understanding of the data structure related to these modules. Robust hands-on design /development of data integration using ETL tools (PowerCentre, DataBricks) and Oracle SQL/PLSQ programming. Should have experience in Oracle DB, ExaData and MS SQL DB. Technical Expertise: Expertise in software development required. Efficient Leadership: Lead, motivate, and drive the team to foster a collaborative environment and empower team members to take ownership of their work while providing guidance, mentorship, and performance management. Outstanding Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication, collaboration, presentation and influencing skills are essential. Stakeholder Management: Ensure regular communication with stakeholders (including communicating project status), manage stakeholder expectations, ensure stakeholder needs are being met and resolve conflicts alongside appropriate GT team members. Planning and Execution: Expert level experience in planning, executing and delivering complex, large-scale initiatives or operation area on time and within budget. Ability to develop and manage project budgets and optimize resource utilization required. Must be highly detailed oriented, well organized, able to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment and serve as a point of escalation for issues. Agile Methodologies: experience understanding Agile methodologies required. Desired Skills and Abilities: Effective Hands-On MS Azure cloud computing is required. Effective datawarehouse, OLAP, SQL, performance tuning and solution architect expertise is required. Outstanding Oracle/SQL Server multi-terabyte Data management expertise is required. Working experience in Waterfall and Agile methodology projects. Technical expertise in DevSec Ops practices preferred. Understanding of delivery and maintenance of applications in the cloud. Proficient with MS Office Suite. Who WE are AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it. How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty. With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward. Learn more at axaxl.com What we OFFER Inclusion AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed. Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe. Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Total Rewards AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do. We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence. Sustainability At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations. Our Pillars: Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans. Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions. Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting. AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving. For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

data.title: Specialist Actuary, Casualty Multinational Solutions
data.description: We are looking for a motivated actuary to join the North America Excess Casualty Insurance Pricing & Analytics team. You will support the Casualty pricing for our Multinational Solutions portfolio. Your main responsibilities will be large, complex account pricing as well as metrics monitoring. The primary role location is in Exton, PA, USA but can be open to candidates local to one of our other east cost offices. What you’ll be doing What will your essential responsibilities include? Primary & Excess Casualty Account Pricing: Utilize various actuarial pricing tools and expertise to produce accurate, timely, and comprehensive account-specific pricing guidance. Guidance will be for primary and/or excess layers for global businesses with large US exposures. Collaborate with local and global program actuaries. Communicate effectively with underwriters. Pricing tool data collection oversight, analysis, quality checking, and reporting. Adhere to and comply with regulatory standards and organizational policies. Builds robust stakeholder relationships and is dedicated to understanding and meeting their needs. Provide specialized training to underwriters on pricing matters, ensuring the team is equipped with the necessary tools and knowledge to make informed decisions. Leverage new technologies and analytical tools to improve pricing models and processes, ensuring the team stays competitive in the market. Engage closely with teams for pricing accuracy and operational alignment including but not limited to: Governance, CUO, Underwriting, Reserving, Claims, Models & Analytics, IT, Compliance, etc. Support the development, testing, calibration, and maintenance of pricing models and complex rating algorithms, including studies on pricing parameters, change impacts, and documentation. Conduct micro portfolio management activities including selection of base loss ratio for business planning, profitability studies & deep dives, dashboard maintenance, and post-event loss evaluations. You will report to a qualified actuary on the Insurance North America Excess Casualty Pricing and Analytics team. You will collaborate closely with the Head of Pricing, Property & Multinational Solutions. What you'd bring We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills: Required Skills and Abilities: Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Applied Math, Statistics, or related field Qualification level – Qualified actuary through the Casualty Actuarial Society Material experience in Property & Casualty actuarial pricing or reserving Motivated, strategic thinker with a robust collaborative work ethic and a focus on quality and integrity Advanced in and significant experience in Excel Legally authorized to work in the posting country Desired Skills and Abilities: Coding proficiency in languages such as Python, R, and SQL, used for data analysis, developing tools, and automating processes is a plus. Exceptional problem-solving, analytical abilities, and attention to detail. Takes full responsibility for deliverables, maintaining high standards and openness to feedback for ongoing improvement. Excellent influencing, negotiating, and communication skills – both verbal and written. A proactive learner continuously seeking opportunities to deepen expertise in actuarial work. Demonstrates robust teamwork skills by actively participating in team activities, contributing to a collaborative environment, and supporting team members in achieving shared goals. Who we are AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it. How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty. With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward. Learn more at axaxl.com What we offer Inclusion AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed. Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe. Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter Learn more at Inclusion & Diversity at AXA XL | AXA XL. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Total Rewards AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do. We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence. Sustainability At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations. Our Pillars: Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans. Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions. Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting. AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving. For more information, please see Sustainability at AXA XL. The U.S. base salary range for this position is US $101,400 - $177,600. Actual pay will be determined based upon the individual’s skills, experience and location. We strive for market alignment and internal equity with our colleagues’ pay. At AXA XL, we know how important physical, mental, and financial health are to our employees, which is why we are proud to offer benefits such as a competitive retirement savings plan, health and wellness programs, and many other benefits. We also believe in fostering our colleagues' development and offer a wide range of learning opportunities for colleagues to hone their professional skills and to position themselves for the next step of their careers. For more details about AXA XL’s benefits offerings, please visit US Benefits at a Glance 2026.
